response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.cnt FROM counts c, avg_c a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(above.cnt) AS avg_above_count, AVG(above.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM above, avg_c a;
